sloka: ततो महात्मा निपपात तस्मिन् शैलोत्तमे वानरसैन्यमध्ये।हर्युत्तमेभ्यः शिरसा ऽभिवाद्य विभीषणं तत्र स सस्वजे च ।। ६.७४.७२ ।।
transliteration: tato mahātmā nipapāta tasmin śailottame vānarasainyamadhye।haryuttamebhyaḥ śirasā 'bhivādya vibhīṣaṇaṁ tatra sa sasvaje ca ।। 6.74.72 ।।

translations.english: The two sons of the ruler of men inhaling the fragrance of the herbs became free from wounds. Other Vanara heroes also got restored.
